offering_description.value: Provides a payment platform that lets consumers pay for digital goods and services through their mobile phone bills or digital wallets. It sells to digital merchants, which pay per transaction, and connects them to mobile network operators and payment methods worldwide.

primary_products.value: carrier billing platform; digital wallet; payment processing software

primary_services.value: payment processing; fraud prevention; merchant onboarding; payment reconciliation

customer_segment.value: B2B: digital content merchants, online game publishers, streaming services, ride-hailing and e-commerce businesses

end_markets.value: digital content; gaming; streaming; ride-hailing; e-commerce

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: fees merchants pay per processed consumer payment

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: payment platform connecting merchants to mobile operators and payment methods, sold to digital merchants; financial intermediary: collects consumer payments and settles funds with merchants

geography_served.value: global: Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, Latin America and other regions through mobile operator partnerships

specialization.value: niche specialist: mobile and carrier billing payment processing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: merchant accounts sold and managed directly by the company; partners / resellers: mobile network operators and payment aggregators that carry the payment method

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: payment services rules, anti-money-laundering and data privacy rules in multiple countries, and card industry security standards

notes: Partner networks, regional coverage and product lines may have changed since my information was last updated.
